title: •Harvest
caption: •Harvest (V)
game_text:
USED: Deploy a device from under your Starting Effect.
STARTING: If your starting location was a Tatooine location, ▼ a farm, two devices, and two always {alter} Effects. Place this Interrupt in Reserve Deck.
lore: “Harvest is when I need you the most. It’s only one season more. This year we’ll make enough on the harvest that I’ll be able to hire some more hands.”
